g.data-detail: The storefront shares the authenticated SQL cart. Page and recently viewed product IDs give the customer agent context.
g.title: The storefront shares the authenticated SQL cart. Page and recently viewed product IDs give the customer agent context.

g.data-detail: The customer agent delegates to retrieval and cart. Typed actions navigate pages. It does not execute generated JavaScript.
g.title: The customer agent delegates to retrieval and cart. Typed actions navigate pages. It does not execute generated JavaScript.

g.data-detail: Cloud LLM plans, rewrites queries, approves chunks in batches, checks coverage and answers. SQL safeguards enforce business invariants.
g.title: Cloud LLM plans, rewrites queries, approves chunks in batches, checks coverage and answers. SQL safeguards enforce business invariants.

g.data-detail: Hybrid and schema-driven SQL retrieval. Keep binary-approved evidence; request follow-up subqueries when coverage is incomplete.
g.title: Hybrid and schema-driven SQL retrieval. Keep binary-approved evidence; request follow-up subqueries when coverage is incomplete.

g.data-detail: Bound customer tools change the cart, read order history and validate reviews. Final checkout confirmation comes from a trusted form.
g.title: Bound customer tools change the cart, read order history and validate reviews. Final checkout confirmation comes from a trusted form.

g.data-detail: SQL stores chat and approved explicit preferences. Separate memory vectors recall only the same customer’s active version.
g.title: SQL stores chat and approved explicit preferences. Separate memory vectors recall only the same customer’s active version.

g.data-detail: Min-max-normalized weighted fusion. SQL filters and fresh product facts are authoritative. Full-category SQL uses pagination.
g.title: Min-max-normalized weighted fusion. SQL filters and fresh product facts are authoritative. Full-category SQL uses pagination.

g.data-detail: Transactions check stock and subtract once on confirmed checkout. Repeated tokens return the same order. SQL triggers update BM25 and queue vectors.
g.title: Transactions check stock and subtract once on confirmed checkout. Repeated tokens return the same order. SQL triggers update BM25 and queue vectors.

g.data-detail: Separate collection; point IDs match SQL memory IDs, with owner/model/version filtering and a SQL recheck.
g.title: Separate collection; point IDs match SQL memory IDs, with owner/model/version filtering and a SQL recheck.

g.data-detail: Persistent keyword index, synchronized by SQL triggers in product-change transactions. It is not a separate BM25 server.
g.title: Persistent keyword index, synchronized by SQL triggers in product-change transactions. It is not a separate BM25 server.

g.data-detail: Derived product vectors and payloads; SQL IDs are shared. Fresh prices, stock and nutrition come from SQL.
g.title: Derived product vectors and payloads; SQL IDs are shared. Fresh prices, stock and nutrition come from SQL.

g.data-detail: Durable product jobs encode latest SQL documents, upsert points, retry safely and reconcile stale/orphan vectors. Memory has separate sync jobs.
g.title: Durable product jobs encode latest SQL documents, upsert points, retry safely and reconcile stale/orphan vectors. Memory has separate sync jobs.

svg.text: Moving arrows show conceptual flow, not live runtime telemetry. Hover a component for details.
